page0.text:
"Hm?"
Sakura's shoes are at the entrance.
Given the time, she must be back from club practice.

page1.text:
"I'm home! ...Oh, Sakura. You're asleep."
I find Sakura asleep in the living room. She must be tired from her club activities.
She's slumped over the table—or rather, lying nearly supine on the tatami floor. She must be exhausted.

page2.text:
"...You would be. Going to school and club practice right after getting sick, and helping me here on top of that. You work yourself too hard, Sakura."
I cross the living room, taking care not to wake her up.
Then,
I bring a blanket from a bedroom.

page3.text:
"Here. You'll catch another cold if you don't cover up."
I gently drape it over her, so as not to disturb her.
And...

page4.text:
"Mm... Senpai..."
Sakura looks up dreamily at me, as if she isn't quite here.

page5.text:
"..."
Something's...different about her.
It's like, she isn't the Sakura I know, who laughs and helps me in the kitchen while wearing an apron. There's something almost...erotic about her that I've never seen.

page6.text:
"S-Sakura, I brought you a blanket..."
I make excuses, failing utterly to hide how bothered I am.
Suddenly,
her arms coil smoothly around my neck.

page7.text:
...
She is close enough to me that I can feel her breathing.
Her fingers caress my neck, and her feminine body fills my vision, meeting no resistance.

page8.text:
"Wha—Sakura, hold on..."
I can't breathe properly nor form a sentence.
Sakura isn't fully awake.
Her drowsy, drunken gaze is proof enough.
So, I should put a stop to this right now and pull away from her...

page9.text:
"Ah...urgh..."
I can't take my eyes off her body.

page10.text:
...I watch the way her hair flows down her neck.
I'm drawn in by the yearning gasps escaping her lips, by her bosom straining against her shirt.
She went and grew up before I knew it. And now, she's right in front of me. It's a dizzying sight.

page11.text:
"Sen...pai..."
The hands around my neck grow a little firmer.
...Her face draws close.
My will to resist slips away, captivated by those charming lips.

page12.text:
...
My rational mind skids to a halt.
Everything I've forbid myself from thinking or noticing—all that boring, useless common sense crumbles away.

page13.text:
"Saku...ra..."
My heart pounds a thunderous rhythm.
The beat is so palpable it's almost painful. I can't think anymore. I'll just—

page15.text:
I leap into the air.
With speed and agility unlike anything I've ever achieved before, I stick the landing on the table!

page16.text:
"That was a splendid maneuver, Shirou. However, you shouldn't stand on the dining table."
"...Right. I just moved on impulse."
I sheepishly get down from the table.
As for Sakura...

page17.text:
"Mm...nngh..."
The arms she had around me are splayed out on the floor, and she's fast asleep again.

page18.text:
"Shirou? You look quite flushed. Are you all right? You also seem unsettled. Is something bothering you?"
"N-not really! Let's take this to the dojo. I want to let Sakura rest, so let's spar until dinner."

page19.text:
"Mhm. I commend your initiative. I am ready to fight thanks to yesterday's rest, so let us prepare for tonight's combat."
Saber goes off to the dojo without questioning my suspicious behavior.
